name: stock-research-automation
description: Autonomous stock research pipeline with a web UI: ticker + thesis in, sourced PDF report + Gamma pitch deck out. Pluggable investment methodologies, constant stock template.

scripts.setup:python: python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install numpy pandas scipy statsmodels yfinance matplotlib
scripts.setup:python:win: python -m venv .venv && .venv\\Scripts\\python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv\\Scripts\\python -m pip install numpy pandas scipy statsmodels yfinance matplotlib
scripts.check: node --check server.js && for f in lib/*.js; do node --check $f || exit 1; done && echo syntax ok
